Class GameBoard

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am02.server.model.GameBoard
public class GameBoard extends Object
Manages the shared physical state of the game board: the two card rows (upper / lower), the building market rows, the offer track, the turn-order tile, and the two decks.

All mutating operations emit notifications through the injected GameEventEmitter. GameBoard is owned by Game and should not be accessed directly by network layers.

  • Constructor Details

    • GameBoard

      public GameBoard(int numPlayers, GameEventEmitter notifier, Random gameRandom)
      Constructs and fully initializes the game board for the given player count. Draws the initial card rows from the freshly built decks.
      Parameters:
      numPlayers - the number of players in the game (2–5)
      notifier - the event emitter used to broadcast board changes; must not be null
      gameRandom - the seeded random source shared with the rest of the game
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if notifier is null

  • Method Details

    • setUpInitialTurnOrder

      public void setUpInitialTurnOrder(List<Player> orderedPlayers)
      Places each player on the turn-order tile in the given order and grants initial food bonuses. Must be called once immediately after board construction.
      Parameters:
      orderedPlayers - players in randomized starting order (index 0 = first player)

    • movePlayerToOffer

      public void movePlayerToOffer(Player player, char tileID)
      Moves a player's totem from the turn-order tile onto the specified offer tile, then fires a totemPlaced notification.
      Parameters:
      player - the player performing the move
      tileID - the target offer tile identifier

    • getPlayersInResolutionOrder

      public List<Player> getPlayersInResolutionOrder()
      Returns:
      an ordered list of players currently on the offer track, sorted by tile ID (ascending), for action-resolution turn order

    • areAllTotemsPlaced

      public boolean areAllTotemsPlaced()
      Returns:
      true if all player totems have been placed on the offer track (i.e. the turn-order tile is empty)

    • initializePlayerLimits

      public void initializePlayerLimits(Player player)
      Initializes the remaining pick counts for the given player based on their offer tile and the number of cards actually available in each row. Fires a playerLimitsInitialized notification.
      Parameters:
      player - the player whose limits are being set up

    • processActionSelection

      public void processActionSelection(Player player, List<String> selectedIDs, Game game)
      Validates and executes a card-selection action for the given player during their turn. Applies food rewards from the offer tile on first call, deducts building costs, transfers cards to the player's tribe, and fires the appropriate notifications.
      Parameters:
      player - the player performing the action
      selectedIDs - list of card IDs the player wishes to acquire
      game - the current game instance, forwarded to building-effect factories
      Throws:
      CardNotFoundException - if a selected card is not on the board
      EventCardNotTakeableException - if a selected card is an event card
      InsufficientFoodException - if the player cannot afford the selected buildings
      PickLimitExceededException - if the selection exceeds the player's remaining pick limits

    • canPlayerFinish

      public boolean canPlayerFinish(Player player)
      Determines whether the given player is allowed to end their turn. A player may end if all mandatory picks are satisfied, or if no characters remain available in a row the player is still obliged to pick from.
      Parameters:
      player - the player requesting to end their turn
      Returns:
      true if the player may legally end their turn

    • movePlayerToTurnOrder

      public void movePlayerToTurnOrder(Player player)
      Moves a player's totem from their offer tile back to the turn-order tile, claiming the earliest free position. Fires a totemReturned notification.
      Parameters:
      player - the player returning their totem

    • applyTurnOrderRewards

      public void applyTurnOrderRewards(Player player)
      Applies end-of-turn food bonuses and penalties defined by the player's position on the turn-order tile. Fires resource-change notifications for each delta.
      Parameters:
      player - the player whose end-of-turn rewards are being resolved

    • getPlayersOnTurnOrderCount

      public int getPlayersOnTurnOrderCount()
      Returns:
      the number of players whose totems are currently on the turn-order tile

    • hasRoundEvents

      public boolean hasRoundEvents()
      Returns:
      true if there is at least one non-final event card visible in the lower row

    • resolveRoundEvents

      public void resolveRoundEvents(List<Player> players)
      Resolves all non-final event cards currently in the lower row, in priority order. Each event's outcome is emitted via the notifier.
      Parameters:
      players - the list of all players (all are affected by events)

    • hasEraChanged

      public boolean hasEraChanged()
      Returns:
      true if the most recently drawn card belongs to a different era than the previous one (signals an era transition)

    • prepareNewRound

      public void prepareNewRound(int numPlayers)
      Prepares the board for a new round: discards the lower row, shifts the upper row down, draws new cards from the tribe deck to refill the upper row, and fires a boardUpdated notification with the full diff.
      Parameters:
      numPlayers - the number of players (determines how many cards to draw)

    • getPlayersInPlacementOrder

      public List<Player> getPlayersInPlacementOrder()
      Returns:
      players in the order they should place their totems for the upcoming round, derived from their current positions on the turn-order tile

    • updateRowsForNewEra

      public void updateRowsForNewEra()
      Updates the building market rows when a new era begins. Moves upper-row buildings to the lower row and draws new buildings for the current era. Discards lower-row buildings when entering Era III. Fires an eraChanged notification.

    • hasFinalEvents

      public boolean hasFinalEvents()
      Returns:
      true if there is at least one final event card in either visible row

    • resolveFinalEvents

      public void resolveFinalEvents(List<Player> players)
      Resolves all final event cards visible in both rows, in priority order.
      Parameters:
      players - the list of all players

    • initializeExtraPlayerLimits

      public void initializeExtraPlayerLimits(Player player, int upperPicks, int lowerPicks)
      Initializes the pick limits for a player's extra turn, capped by the actual number of cards available in each row. Fires a playerLimitsInitialized notification.
      Parameters:
      player - the player receiving the extra turn
      upperPicks - the maximum number of upper-row picks for the extra turn
      lowerPicks - the maximum number of lower-row picks for the extra turn

    • processExtraActionSelection

      public void processExtraActionSelection(Player player, List<String> selectedIDs, Game game)
      Validates and executes a card-selection action during a player's extra turn. Behaves like processActionSelection(Player, List, Game) but uses the extra-turn pick counters.
      Parameters:
      player - the player performing the extra-turn action
      selectedIDs - list of card IDs the player wishes to acquire
      game - the current game instance
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the selection exceeds extra-turn pick limits
      CardNotFoundException - if a selected card is not on the board
      InsufficientFoodException - if the player cannot afford the selected buildings
